evidence: Has the P2P label and modifies Tor onion service listener binding and peer address classification behavior.
rationale: Prevents Tor peers arriving on shared binds from being misclassified by IP and inheriting whitelist permissions assigned to the Tor daemon. According to the PR description, without a dedicated onion bind, 'Tor peers arriving through shared or wildcard binds may be classified by IP and inherit address-based whitelist permissions', making this an important security and privacy guard for P2P connection handling.
